_doc: BASELINE of pre-existing LINKAGE BREAKS. DEBT REGISTER, not approval. NEW breaks fail the build. Wire an edge and DELETE its entry. SCOPE: this guard proves SCHEMA REACHABILITY only -- it cannot prove rows are populated or that reverse UI exists. Population + reverse drill-through are separate audits.

entries.reason: WO-CLAIM-MONEY — no claim_id/matter_id on an expense, so a deductible or legal fee cannot be traced to the claim that caused it.
WO-CLAIM-MONEY — claim generates no expense/bill/JE. Deductible, legal fees, repairs never reach the books from the claim.
